# models.codelove.in — 6,792 free 3D models (GLB)

> A free library of 6,792 ready-to-use 3D models: 115 rigged human characters with 20 animation clips, animals, vehicles, buildings, furniture, food, nature, trees, space, weapons and game kits. Every model is one glTF 2.0 binary file (.glb) with a direct download URL — no sign-up, no API key — and free for personal and commercial use (MIT, CC0 or public domain; a few hairstyles are CC BY / CC BY-ND and need credit).

Site: https://models.codelove.in/ · Made by Gowtham

Every model on the site, grouped by collection. Paths are relative to https://models.codelove.in — for example the model page
/models/<slug>/ is https://models.codelove.in/models/<slug>/ and a .glb path /library/… is https://models.codelove.in/library/….
Each line: name and model page — .glb path · triangles · size · file size, then notes (rigged, animations, a license that differs from the collection's, required credit).
Overview, licenses and code samples: https://models.codelove.in/llms.txt · JSON version: https://models.codelove.in/catalog.json

## Using the files

- Format: glTF 2.0 binary (.glb), one file per model with textures embedded, compressed with EXT_meshopt_compression and EXT_texture_webp. three.js (GLTFLoader + MeshoptDecoder; drei's useGLTF sets this up) and Babylon.js load them directly; other engines need meshopt support or a decompressed copy.
- Size is the bounding box (width × height × depth) in glTF units, which are metres by the glTF spec; models are Y-up. A few imported models are not to real-world scale, so scale them to fit.
- Rigged humans use a Biped skeleton (root bone Bip01; the child characters use Bip02). The 20 animation clips (10 motions: idle, look around, talk, thoughtful, wave, cheer, clap, dance, walk, run) are separate skeleton-only .glb files in a female (f_) and a male (m_) set: load a character and a clip from its set, then play the clip with THREE.AnimationMixer — the bone names match.
- Each .glb carries its license and credit in the glTF asset block (asset.copyright, asset.extras).

## Licenses

- MIT License — 142 models and all 20 animation clips: Keep the included license file with the model when you ship or share it. https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT
- CC0 1.0 — public domain — 6,392 models: No attribution required. https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
- Public domain — 244 models: No attribution required; don't use insignia or logos shown on the model to imply endorsement. https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/
- CC BY 4.0 — 11 models: Credit the author (named on the model page, in the file and in ATTRIBUTION.txt) when you use or share it. https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
- CC BY-ND 4.0 — 3 models: Credit the author (named on the model page, in the file and in ATTRIBUTION.txt) when you use or share it, and share only unmodified copies. https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nd/4.0/
